D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.name: D5.S1.Dynamics.Symbolic.PermutativeLifts.BalancedLift.orbit_closure_family_card
D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.signature: theorem orbit_closure_family_card {k : ℕ} {h : (Fin (k + 2) → Bool) → Bool} (bh : Bipermutative h) : Nat.card (Set.range (fun x : LiftPoint h balancedSubshift => closure (AddAction.orbit ℤ x))) = 2 ^ (k + 1)

D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.name: D5.S1.Dynamics.Symbolic.PermutativeLifts.BalancedLift.full_lift_not_minimal
D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.signature: theorem full_lift_not_minimal {k : ℕ} {h : (Fin (k + 2) → Bool) → Bool} (bh : Bipermutative h) : ¬ AddAction.IsMinimal ℤ (LiftPoint h balancedSubshift)

D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.name: D5.S1.Dynamics.Symbolic.PermutativeLifts.BalancedLift.splitting_conjugacy
D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.signature: theorem splitting_conjugacy {k : ℕ} {h : (Fin (k + 2) → Bool) → Bool} (bh : Bipermutative h) (x : LiftPoint h balancedSubshift) : splitting bh (liftShift balancedSubshift x) = (shiftBalanced 1 (splitting bh x).1, (splitting bh x).2)

D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.name: D5.S1.Dynamics.Symbolic.PermutativeLifts.Balanced.balanced_orbit_dense
D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.signature: theorem balanced_orbit_dense (y : BalancedPoint) : DenseRange (fun g : ℤ => shiftBalanced g y)

D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.name: D5.S1.Dynamics.Symbolic.PermutativeLifts.Balanced.exists_balanced_regular_toeplitz_generator
D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.signature: theorem exists_balanced_regular_toeplitz_generator : ∃ y : ℤ → Bool, y ∈ balancedSubshift.carrier ∧ HasPeriodicCoordinates y ∧ (∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → shift (p : ℤ) y ≠ y) ∧ closure (Set.range (fun g : ℤ => shift g y)) = balancedSubshift.carrier ∧ ∃ P : PeriodStructure y, Tendsto P.skeletonDensity atTop (𝓝 1)

D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.name: D5.S1.Dynamics.Symbolic.PermutativeLifts.Balanced.balanced_unique_ergodic
D5/S1/Dynamics/Symbolic/PermutativeLifts.signature: theorem balanced_unique_ergodic : ∃! μ : Measure BalancedPoint, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧ MeasurePreserving (shiftBalanced 1) μ μ
